{"action":"shell","command":"cd /testbed && PYTHONPATH=src:. python -c "
from cachetools.tagged import TaggedCache

# Test R01: basic put/get with tags
c = TaggedCache(2)
c.put('a', 1, ['x'])
assert c.get('a') == 1
c.put('a', 2, ['y'])  # replace
c.put('b', 3, ['x'])
assert c.get('a') == 2
assert c.get('b') == 3

# Test R02: invalidate
c2 = TaggedCache(3)
c2.put('a', 1, ['x'])
c2.put('b', 2, ['x','y'])
c2.put('c', 3, ['y'])
assert c2.invalidate('x') == 2  # a and b
assert len(c2) == 1
assert c2.get('c') == 3

# Test R03: maxsize validation
try:
    TaggedCache(-1)
    assert False
except ValueError:
    pass
try:
    TaggedCache(True)
    assert False
except ValueError:
    pass

# Test R04: invalidate_many
import warnings
with warnings.catch_warnings():
    warnings.simplefilter('ignore')
    c3 = TaggedCache(5)
c3.put('a', 1, ['x','z'])
c3.put('b', 2, ['x','y'])
c3.put('c', 3, ['y'])
c3.put('d', 4, ['z'])
assert c3.invalidate_many(['x','y'], 'any') == 3  # a,b,c
assert len(c3) == 1
assert c3.get('d') == 4
assert c3.invalidate_many(['x','y'], 'all') == 0  # no key has both
# d has only z, a was already removed
c3.invalidate_many(['z'], 'all')  # d has z but needs all... wait, only one tag
assert len(c3) == 0

# Test R05: resize
c4 = TaggedCache(3)
c4.put('a', 1, ['x'])
c4.put('b', 2, ['y'])
c4.put('c', 3, ['z'])
c4.resize(2)
assert c4.maxsize == 2
assert len(c4) == 2  # 'a' evicted
assert c4.get('b') == 2
assert c4.get('c') == 3

# Test R06: generators as tags
c5 = TaggedCache(3)
c5.put('a', [1, {'nested': True}], (t for t in ['x']))
val = c5.get('a')
assert val == [1, {'nested': True}]
val['nested'] = False
assert c5.get('a')['nested'] == True  # detached

# Test R07/R08: TTL
c6 = TaggedCache(2, timer=lambda: 0)
c6.put('a', 1, ttl=2)
assert c6.get('a') == 1
c6._timer = lambda: 1.5
assert c6.get('a') == 1  # not yet expired
c6._timer = lambda: 2
with __import__('pytest').raises(KeyError):
    c6.get('a')  # expired at boundary
c6.put('b', 2, ttl=0)  # immediately expired
assert len(c6) == 0

# Test invalid tags
try:
    TaggedCache(1).put('a', 1, 'string')
    assert False
except ValueError:
    pass
try:
    TaggedCache(1).put('a', 1, [1, 2])
    assert False
except ValueError:
    pass

print('All manual tests passed!')
